recordFields.nameRaw: Exact source bytes32 hex; retained even when no display string is available.
recordFields.decodedName: Exact source string when present; null for source boolean markers.
recordFields.decodeStatus: Source-derived display/decode classification, not a fresh byte decoder.

limitations: This deterministic artifact reflects a checked-in source snapshot, not current contract storage or a complete CatNamed event history.
Raw bytes32 values are retained; invalid or unparsed source markers are not normalized into replacement-character strings.
The snapshot does not establish current ownership, active adoption offers, current display moderation, or live named counts.
